Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.description: What data this site handles, and why.
paragraphs: This is a starter notice for the site. Replace it with the final legal text before publishing.
Innova Design, in Puebla, Mexico, is responsible for the site. The contact email is hola@innovadesign.mx.
The contact form does not send data to our server: it opens your mail app. If you write to us, we use your name, email, and message only to reply.
Your cookie choice and light or dark theme are stored in your browser's local storage. You can clear them in the browser settings.
To ask for access, correction, or deletion of a message you sent us, write to hola@innovadesign.mx.

Cookies.title: Cookie notice
Cookies.description: How this site uses the cookie preference.
paragraphs: This version of the site does not load third-party analytics.
If you accept or reject the notice, we store that choice in the browser's local storage so the banner does not return.
The light or dark theme is also remembered in the same browser. It is not sent to a server.
You can delete those keys from your browser settings.
